articles.title: Chinese humanoid robot beats Bolt’s time
articles.dek: A Chinese humanoid robot ran the 100-meter dash nearly two-tenths of a second faster than world-record holder Usain Bolt at Beijing’s “Robot Olympics” on Saturday.

articles.title: Las Vegas Raiders' Ashton Jeanty suffers apparent injury during practice
articles.dek: Las Vegas Raiders running back Ashton Jeanty had to be helped off the field after apparently being injured late in Sunday's practice and was unable to put pressure on his right leg.

articles.title: Trump and former fixer Michael Cohen make amends
articles.dek: President Trump signaled that he's welcomed his former fixer, Michael Cohen, back into his good graces in a remarkably friendly interview that aired in full on Sunday. The big picture: The president and Cohen discussed a wide range of topics, including Trump's proposed ballroom, how the economy is doing during his second term and how so-called "weaponization" is destroying America. The interview is the first time Trump and Cohen have spoken publicly since the attorney was a key witness in the hush money trial that led to Trump's conviction on 34 felony counts of falsifying business records. articles.dek: Wyndham Clark had reason to feel this was similar to the U.S. Open.

articles.title: Gauff beats Pegula for 2nd Cincinnati Open title; France's Fils beats American Tiafoe in men's final
articles.dek: Coco Gauff defeated fellow American Jessica Pegula, 6-2, 6-4, to capture her second women's Cincinnati Open title on Sunday, and Arthur Fils of France defeated American Frances Tiafoe 6-3, 1-6, 6-0 in the men's final for his first Masters 1000 title.

articles.title: Rays veteran pitcher Nick Martinez proves to be an effective skid stopper for AL East leaders
articles.dek: Mired in an uncomfortable slump that uncomfortably shortened their lead in the AL East, the Tampa Bay Rays were desperate for a victory.

articles.title: Paige Bueckers scores 18 of her 32 in 1st quarter, Wings beat Storm 92-70
articles.dek: Paige Bueckers scored 18 of her 32 points in the first quarter, Jessica Shepard had 11 points and 11 rebounds, and the Dallas Wings beat the Seattle Storm 92-70 to tie the franchise's single-season wins record.

articles.title: Serena Williams and Carlos Alcaraz will start US Open mixed doubles against team from qualifying
articles.dek: Serena Williams and Carlos Alcaraz will have to wait a little longer to learn their first opponent in the U.S. Open mixed doubles championship.

articles.title: Monken says Watson's postgame comments won't factor in decision about Browns starting QB
articles.dek: Todd Monken will take at least one more day before deciding if Shedeur Sanders or Deshaun Watson will be the Cleveland Browns starting quarterback on Sept. 13 in Jacksonville.

articles.title: Shelley Fabares, 'Johnny Angel' singer and actor in 'The Donna Reed Show' and 'Coach,' dies at 82
articles.dek: Shelley Fabares, a beloved television actor known for roles on "The Donna Reed Show," "One Day at a Time," and "Coach," has died at 82.

articles.title: Torres scores twice in debut for PSG, Barcelona wins big and Salah scores
articles.dek: Ferran Torres has scored twice in his Paris Saint-Germain debut to help the French defending champion draw 2-2 at Rennes in its league opener, while Barcelona began defense of the Spanish league title with a 5-0 rout of Elche.

articles.title: Muncy's solo homer caps off A's rally as Oakland beats Houston 7-6
articles.dek: Max Muncy hit a go-ahead solo homer in the seventh inning and the Athletics rallied from a six-run deficit to beat the Houston Astros 7-6 on Sunday.

articles.title: Thousands evacuate as wildfire approaches Reno
articles.dek: Officials say a fast-growing wildfire in Reno, Nevada, was human-caused. The Hawk Fire grew to 13,000 acres Sunday and is uncontained.

articles.title: 2028 Dems dodge on Bernie's push to pause AI development
articles.dek: Democratic presidential hopefuls are scrambling to seize on the growing public backlash against AI. But none will go as far as Bernie Sanders and his recent call to halt the technology's development. Axios asked nearly 20 Democrats who are seen as potential White House contenders whether they support Sanders' call for AI CEOs to "stop building machines that humans cannot control." Only one directly answered the question. articles.dek: The Jets signed edge rusher Anthony Dunn, running back Dominic Richardson and safety Tanner Wall.
